en-US.summary: Check real-time ferry schedules from Red Hook Brooklyn with official NYC Ferry data and service alerts
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask red hook ferry when is the next ferry
Alexa, ask red hook ferry for ferries to Wall Street
Alexa, ask red hook ferry are there any service alerts
en-US.name: Red Hook Ferry Checker
en-US.description: Red Hook Ferry Checker provides real-time ferry schedules and service alerts for NYC Ferry's Red Hook route in Brooklyn. This skill uses official GTFS data to provide up-to-the-minute departure times for ferries heading to Wall Street/Pier 11, East 34th Street, Governors Island, and more. Users can check for the next boat, ask about ferries at a specific time, and stay informed about service disruptions or delays.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: This skill provides real-time NYC Ferry schedules for the Red Hook route in Brooklyn. Test with phrases like 'when is the next ferry', 'ferries to Wall Street', or 'are there any service alerts'.
